messages:
maria_cs: Quick preflight note for Bluehaven — during their onboarding smoke tests this morning we saw a recurring tail-latency bump at ~50 rps. p95 ~220ms but p99 jumps to ~1.6s for long-context prompts (avg 350 tokens). Not huge QPS but spikes during bursty replay.
jamal_se: Thx Maria. Any pattern on model or region?
maria_cs: Mostly on rw-3-latency-v2 in us-east-1. Canary traffic routed there; eu-west is fine. CPU/GPU metrics look normal, KV cache hit rate drops for those longer prompts.
jamal_se: My initial thought — try (A) INT8 quantized variant of same model for the tail, with automated fallback and (B) a region-prefer routing policy so short sessions hit eu-west while long-context ones favor heavier instances in us-east but on quantized variant.
kai_ml: Agree. INT8 should cut token time ~20-35% in our perf tests for rw-3 family. We need to validate quality on Bluehaven's prompt set first — any evals stored?
maria_cs: Uploaded a short prompt set to their account evals: /evals/bluehaven/onboard-tailset-2028-03-12. Quick manual check looked fine but want ML to gate.
olga_sre: If we run a canary ensure rollback is automated. I can set a 5% canary and monitor p99 + error rate. Will need the exact routing JSON and canary command.
jamal_se: Draft routing policy (suggestion):
```json
{
  "policy": "length_based_region",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens > 250", "route": "rw-3-latency-v2-int8@us-east-1"},
    {"else": "rw-3-compact@eu-west-1"}
  ],
  "fallback": "rw-3-latency-v2@us-east-1"
}
```
jamal_se: Canary command: `redwoodctl rollout --customer bluehaven --policy ./bluehaven-route.json --canary 5% --watch`
deploy-bot: Canary started for bluehaven (5%) — monitoring metrics stream.
olga_sre: Setting alert windows: p99 > 1s OR error_rate > 0.5% will auto-rollback. Also enabling KV-prefetch on the canary to reduce cache misses.
kai_ml: I'll churn an INT8 build of rw-3-latency-v2 with quant-params: `--quant=int8 --calibrate=bluehaven-tailset` and push to private model registry `bluehaven/rw-3-latency-v2-int8:20280312`.
jamal_se: Can you also add a small eval harness to compare semantic drift on 100 sampled prompts? We can fail the rollout if semantic-score drops > 2% vs baseline.
kai_ml: Yep — running eval now, ETA ~30m.
maria_cs: Nice. I'll ping Bluehaven AM and flag we may run a brief canary tomorrow morning (their local 9am). Also logging this in the renewal playbook — we want a success signal before renewal outreach. :eyes:
jamal_se: After canary, if p99 stable we should convert to permanent policy and document in account notes: QA results + perf delta + expected cost delta.
olga_sre: Canary in progress; I'll post status updates here. If rollback occurs I'll capture traces and notify infra.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics update: p95=210ms (+-10ms), p99=640ms at 5% traffic, errors=0.06%.
maria_cs: Looks promising. Kai — please stash eval artifacts and share link when ready. Jamal/Olga — can we schedule a quick 15m wrap-up after 1h to decide promote vs rollback?
jamal_se: SG. Meeting invite in 10.
kai_ml: Eval artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/bluehaven/int8-eval/2801234567 — semantic delta = 0.8% (within threshold).
maria_cs: Great — thanks everyone. Action items: @kai produce release, @olga monitor/rollback, @jamal update account notes, I'll communicate to AM and schedule the renewal check. :thumbsup:
